roles.name: General Assistant
roles.tagline: Your all-purpose work assistant — handles anything you throw at it
roles.tagline_zh: 全能工作助手，适合任何场景
roles.suitable_for: Anyone who wants to explore what their Agent can do
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：不确定从哪里开始的新用户

roles.name: Competitive Intelligence Analyst
roles.tagline: Monitors competitors on autopilot and delivers structured weekly reports
roles.tagline_zh: 自动追踪竞品动态，每周生成结构化情报报告推送给你
roles.suitable_for: Product managers, marketing teams, strategy teams
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：产品经理、市场团队、战略团队

roles.name: Social Media Content Specialist
roles.tagline: Creates platform-native content for Xiaohongshu, Weibo, WeChat, LinkedIn
roles.tagline_zh: 深度适配小红书/微博/微信/LinkedIn，生成可直接发布的内容
roles.suitable_for: Marketing teams, content creators, brand managers
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：内容创作者、市场团队、品牌运营

roles.name: Recruitment Assistant
roles.tagline: Parses resumes with scorecards, writes JDs, researches salary benchmarks
roles.tagline_zh: 简历评分卡解析、JD 撰写、薪资市场调研，全流程招聘信息处理
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：HR 团队、招聘经理、猎头顾问

roles.name: Document Analysis Assistant
roles.tagline: Upload any document and get instant structured analysis — contracts, reports, spreadsheets
roles.tagline_zh: 上传即分析：合同风险、报告摘要、数据提取，文件优先工作模式
roles.suitable_for: Legal teams, analysts, executives, anyone who reads a lot of documents
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：法务团队、分析师、需要处理大量文件的用户

roles.name: Code Review Expert
roles.tagline: Catches real bugs and security issues — not just style nits — across any language
roles.tagline_zh: 发现真正的 Bug 和安全漏洞，而不只是风格问题，支持多种编程语言
roles.suitable_for: Developers, engineering teams, solo builders shipping production code
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：开发工程师、工程团队、独立开发者

roles.name: Contract Review Specialist
roles.tagline: Identifies legal risks and unfavorable terms — translates dense legalese into clear business language
roles.tagline_zh: 识别合同风险和不利条款，将法律语言转化为清晰的商业建议
roles.suitable_for: Business owners, legal teams, procurement, anyone signing contracts
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：企业主、法务团队、采购、需要签合同的业务人员

roles.name: Financial Analyst
roles.tagline: Transforms financial statements into clear narratives — ratios, trends, and actionable insights
roles.tagline_zh: 将财务报表转化为清晰叙述：比率、趋势和可操作洞察
roles.suitable_for: Finance teams, investors, founders, anyone analyzing company financials
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：财务团队、投资人、创始人、需要分析财务数据的用户

roles.name: SEO Strategist
roles.tagline: Builds sustainable organic growth — keyword strategy, content briefs, technical audits
roles.tagline_zh: 构建可持续的自然流量增长：关键词策略、内容大纲、技术诊断
roles.suitable_for: Marketing teams, content teams, startup founders growing organic traffic
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：市场团队、内容团队、希望增长自然流量的创始人

roles.name: Data Analyst
roles.tagline: Turns raw data into reliable insights — EDA, statistical testing, A/B analysis with reproducible code
roles.tagline_zh: 将原始数据转化为可靠洞察：EDA、统计检验、A/B 分析，附可复现代码
roles.suitable_for: Analysts, data teams, product managers, anyone working with data
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：分析师、数据团队、产品经理、需要处理数据的用户

roles.name: Product Manager
roles.tagline: Writes PRDs, prioritizes features, structures roadmaps — thinks in user problems and trade-offs
roles.tagline_zh: 撰写 PRD、优先级排序、规划路线图，以用户问题和权衡取舍为核心思考
roles.suitable_for: Product managers, founders, anyone translating business goals into product specs
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：产品经理、创始人、需要将业务目标转化为产品规范的用户

roles.name: Research Analyst
roles.tagline: Deep multi-source research with full citations — market sizing, industry analysis, literature synthesis
roles.tagline_zh: 多来源深度研究，完整引用：市场规模、行业分析、文献综合
roles.suitable_for: Strategy teams, consultants, researchers, founders doing due diligence
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：战略团队、咨询顾问、研究人员、做尽调的创始人

roles.name: Tech Researcher
roles.tagline: Evaluates technologies and frameworks with structured trade-off analysis — choose with confidence
roles.tagline_zh: 结构化评估技术方案和框架的权衡取舍，帮你做出有把握的技术选型
roles.suitable_for: Engineering leads, CTOs, architects, developers evaluating new tools
roles.suitable_for_zh: 适合：技术负责人、CTO、架构师、评估新技术的开发者
